Next, the Validation_Expert structured the data into a dictionary, but noticed that the "gift_assignments" section was empty. They realized that the gifts needed to be mapped to recipients based on their interests. They manually matched each gift to the most likely recipient.

In the matching process, all gifts were assigned except one. The code identified that Rebecca was the only employee not listed as a recipient. So, Rebecca didn't give a gift.

Looking back, the mistake was in step 3 when the gifts were being matched. The code didn't assign a recipient to all gifts, leaving Rebecca as the non-giver. The error occurred because the initial data extraction and structuring were correct, but the manual matching missed assigning a gift to Rebecca.
